Description: READ ONLY designs. No policy attached. Instance profile shared by other workstation instances; explicitly evaluate exposure before approving.
SecurityReview: The same base role is used by more than one EC2 workstation; any instance holding that role could potentially assume the export role if its policy allows it.
Prefer separate dedicated profile for certificate-bearing workstation if feasible without modifying GPU acceptance constraints.
Never add route53:ChangeResourceRecordSets to the existing workstation role for this architecture.
The export role must be limited to exactly one ACM certificate ARN; no wildcard. Do not store exported keys in SSM, GitHub or CI.
